concepts.label: cbstats latency/count histogram format
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the mechanism-level reporting format cbstats uses for per-operation timing distributions: a named operation (e.g. 'commit') broken into exponential time-range buckets, each carrying a cumulative percentage and a raw count. This is the actual shape of kvtimings' own output and is worth naming once at this level rather than per-bucket-row; the same format recurs verbatim in cbstats-raw's histograms in this same batch.

notable_absence.finding: This page's Description section and 'Table 1. Couchstore database engine stats' (backend_type, close, failure_get, failure_open, failure_set, failure_vbset, lastCommDocs, numLoadedVb, open) are copy-pasted verbatim, word for word, from cbstats-kvstore.md - but kvtimings' own worked example returns a latency histogram for the operation 'commit' with millisecond-bucketed percentiles ('rw_3:commit (50457 total)' ... '4ms - 8ms : ( 67.06%) 28528'), not any of the fields the table describes. The documented table describes the wrong command's output entirely - direct, quotable evidence of the copy-paste-across-subcommands pattern this round's framing hypothesis was watching for.

cross_component_finding: The same bucketed time-range histogram shape ('Xms - Yms : (P%) count') reappears in cbstats-raw's 'raw timings' example in this batch (access_scanner_*, checkpoint_remover_*, store_cmd_*), suggesting a single shared histogram-rendering mechanism inside cbstats used across several unrelated subcommands rather than something specific to kvtimings.
cross_product_finding: Not applicable - no cross-product content on this page.
